name: Classic Who
description: The Doctor, a Time Lord who cheats death by regenerating into a new face, travels time and space in the TARDIS, a ship disguised as a police box. With companions from Earth and beyond, the Doctor takes on alien invaders and would-be tyrants across history and other worlds.

name: Wilderness Years
description: The years when Doctor Who was off the air, between the end of the original series and its revival. The Doctor lived on in a television film, charity specials and animated stories made for the BBC website.

name: New Who
description: The Doctor returns, still travelling time and space in the TARDIS with companions whose lives are changed by the journey. The revived series follows the Time Lord across history, the far future and other worlds, saving civilisations and facing enemies old and new, one regeneration after another.

name: Torchwood
description: Captain Jack Harkness leads Torchwood, a secret institute founded by the Crown, from a hidden base in Cardiff where alien and supernatural trouble falls through the Rift. The darker spin-off made for adults, where saving the world comes at a personal cost.

name: The Sarah Jane Adventures
description: Journalist Sarah Jane Smith, the Doctor's longest-serving companion, investigates alien threats on Earth from her attic on Bannerman Road. Her adopted son Luke, his friends and a supercomputer in the wall help her keep the street, and the planet, safe.

name: Class
description: The sixth-formers of Coal Hill Academy juggle friends, parents and exams while guarding a tear in space and time left by the Doctor's many visits. An alien prince and his exiled guardian hide among them, and whatever comes through the tear comes for the school.

name: The War Between the Land and the Sea
description: An ancient species rises from the ocean to reclaim the planet, and the world is plunged into crisis. UNIT stands between humanity and the deep, in a war fought where the land meets the sea.

name: Complete Chronology
description: Every Doctor Who story in one running order, from the first episode to the newest, with the spin-offs alongside the show they grew out of.
